<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>FPI Inflows:</strong> Foreign Portfolio Investors have invested ₹23,544 crore in Indian equities during August, supported by a revival in corporate earnings and relative rupee stability.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
